sentence: O tempo não está bom hoje, não vou sair.
ipa: u ˈtẽpu ˈnɐ̃w̃ esˈta ˈbõ ˈoʒi ˈnɐ̃w̃ ˈvow ˈsajɾ
gloss_en: The weather is not good today, I'm not going out.
notes: Nasal diphthong 'não' [ˈnɐ̃w̃] and final-vowel raising 'hoje' [ˈoʒi]; BR base keeps an alveolar coda /s/ (no chiado) per camara1970 and barbosa_albano2004.

sentence: Essas duas camisas custam trinta reais.
ipa: ˈes̺as ˈduas kaˈmizas ˈkustɐ̃w̃ ˈtɾĩtɐ ʁeˈajs
gloss_en: These two shirts cost thirty reais.
notes: Intervocalic 's' voiced 'camisas' [kaˈmizas] with alveolar coda [s], strong onset /r/ 'reais' [ʁeˈajs] per barbosa_albano2004 and callou_leite2001.

sentence: A consulta é amanhã às três da tarde.
ipa: ɐ kõˈsuwtɐ ˈɛ amaˈɲã as ˈtɾes dɐ ˈtaɾd͡ʒi
gloss_en: The appointment is tomorrow at three in the afternoon.
notes: Palatal [ɲ] 'amanhã', coda /l/ vocalised 'consulta' [kõˈsuwtɐ] and open-mid [ɛ] per camara1970 and mateus_dandrade2000.

sentence: Meu irmão mora perto daqui com a família.
ipa: ˈmew iɾˈmɐ̃w̃ ˈmɔɾɐ ˈpeɾtu daˈki kõ ɐ faˈmiliɐ
gloss_en: My brother lives near here with the family.
notes: Nasal diphthong 'irmão' [iˈɾmɐ̃w̃] and vowel-initial liaison 'com a' per mateus_dandrade2000 and barbosa_albano2004.

sentence: Vira à direita e segue reto até a praça.
ipa: ˈviɾɐ a d͡ʒiˈɾejtɐ i ˈseɡi ˈʁetu aˈtɛ ɐ ˈpɾasɐ
gloss_en: Turn right and keep straight on until the square.
notes: Affrication of /d/ before [i] 'direita' [d͡ʒiˈɾejtɐ] and strong onset /r/ 'reto' [ˈʁetu] per barbosa_albano2004 and camara1970.

sentence: A comida daquele restaurante estava deliciosa.
ipa: ɐ koˈmidɐ daˈkeli ʁestawˈɾɐ̃t͡ʃi esˈtavɐ delis̺iˈozɐ
gloss_en: The food at that restaurant was delicious.
notes: Strong onset /r/ 'restaurante' [ʁ] and light BR pretonic (retained /e o/) per callou_leite2001 and camara1970.

sentence: Onde é que a gente pega o ônibus pro centro?
ipa: ˈõd͡ʒi ˈɛ ki ɐ ˈʒẽt͡ʃi ˈpeɡɐ u ˈonibus ˈpɾu ˈs̺ẽtɾu
gloss_en: Where do we catch the bus to downtown?
notes: Colloquial BR lexicon 'a gente'/'ônibus'; open-mid [ɛ] 'é' and elision 'que a gente' per callou_leite2001 and mateus_dandrade2000.

sentence: Quantas pessoas você vai levar na viagem?
ipa: ˈkwɐ̃tas peˈs̺oas voˈs̺e ˈvaj leˈvaɾ nɐ viˈaʒẽj̃
gloss_en: How many people are you taking on the trip?
notes: 'você' address with 3sg verb; coda /r/ realised as tap 'levar' [leˈvaɾ] per barbosa_albano2004 and camara1970.

sentence: Se eu pudesse, comprava aquela casa azul.
ipa: si ˈew puˈdes̺i kõˈpɾavɐ aˈkelɐ ˈkazɐ aˈzuw
gloss_en: If I could, I would buy that blue house.
notes: Coda /l/ vocalised 'azul' [aˈzuw] and final raising 'pudesse' [puˈdes̺i] per camara1970 and callou_leite2001.

sentence: Ontem eu comprei frutas e verduras na feira.
ipa: ˈõtẽj̃ ˈew kõˈpɾej ˈfɾutas i veɾˈduɾas nɐ ˈfejɾɐ
gloss_en: Yesterday I bought fruit and vegetables at the market.
notes: 'ei' diphthong retained 'feira' [ˈfejɾɐ], coda /r/ tap 'verduras' and 'frutas e' liaison per barbosa_albano2004 and callou_leite2001.

sentence: Semana que vem a gente vai viajar de trem.
ipa: seˈmanɐ ki ˈvẽj̃ ɐ ˈʒẽt͡ʃi ˈvaj viaˈʒaɾ d͡ʒi ˈtɾẽj̃
gloss_en: Next week we're going to travel by train.
notes: BR lexicon 'a gente'/'trem'; nasal [ẽ] 'vem'/'trem' and coda /r/ tap 'viajar' per callou_leite2001 and camara1970.

sentence: Me liga quando você chegar em casa, tá legal?
ipa: mi ˈliɡɐ ˈkwɐ̃du voˈs̺e ʃeˈɡaɾ ẽj̃ ˈkazɐ ˈta leˈɡaw
gloss_en: Call me when you get home, all right?
notes: Imperative clitic 'me liga'; coda /l/ vocalised 'legal' [leˈɡaw], coda /r/ tap 'chegar' per camara1970 and barbosa_albano2004.

sentence: Bom dia, tudo bem com você hoje?
ipa: ˈbõ ˈd͡ʒiɐ ˈtudu ˈbẽj̃ kõ voˈs̺e ˈoʒi
gloss_en: Good morning, how are you today?
notes: Greeting register with 'você'; affrication /d/ before [i] 'dia' [ˈd͡ʒiɐ] and nasal [õ]/[ẽ] per barbosa_albano2004 and mateus_dandrade2000.

sentence: Quem não arrisca não petisca.
ipa: ˈkẽj̃ ˈnɐ̃w̃ aˈʁiskɐ ˈnɐ̃w̃ peˈt͡ʃiskɐ
gloss_en: Nothing ventured, nothing gained.
notes: Proverb attested in cunha_cintra1984; strong onset /r/ 'arrisca' [aˈʁiskɐ] and affrication 'petisca' [peˈt͡ʃiskɐ] per barbosa_albano2004.

sentence: O gato preto estava dormindo no sofá da sala.
ipa: u ˈɡatu ˈpɾetu esˈtavɐ doɾˈmĩdu nu soˈfa dɐ ˈsalɐ
gloss_en: The black cat was sleeping on the living-room sofa.
notes: 'gato' [ˈɡatu] final raising and BR estar+gerúndio 'estava dormindo' per camara1970 and barbosa_albano2004.

sentence: Aquele rato correu pro buraco do muro.
ipa: aˈkeli ˈʁatu koˈʁew ˈpɾu buˈɾaku du ˈmuɾu
gloss_en: That mouse ran into the hole in the wall.
notes: 'rato' [ˈʁatu] with strong initial /r/ and final raising 'muro' [ˈmuɾu] per barbosa_albano2004 and camara1970.

sentence: O mundo inteiro fala desse assunto agora.
ipa: u ˈmũdu ĩˈtejɾu ˈfalɐ ˈdes̺i aˈs̺ũtu aˈɡoɾɐ
gloss_en: The whole world is talking about this subject now.
notes: Nasal 'mundo' [ˈmũdu] and 'ei' diphthong 'inteiro'; 'mundo inteiro' junction per mateus_dandrade2000 and camara1970.

sentence: Ele é muito chato quando bebe demais.
ipa: ˈeli ˈɛ ˈmujtu ˈʃatu ˈkwɐ̃du ˈbebi deˈmajs
gloss_en: He is very annoying when he drinks too much.
notes: Lexical [ʃ] 'chato' and open-mid [ɛ] 'é'; nasal [ɐ̃] 'quando' and 'ele é' elision per barbosa_albano2004 and mateus_dandrade2000.

sentence: A tia trouxe leite e pão doce de tarde.
ipa: ɐ ˈt͡ʃiɐ ˈtɾowsi ˈlejt͡ʃi i ˈpɐ̃w̃ ˈdos̺i d͡ʒi ˈtaɾd͡ʒi
gloss_en: Auntie brought milk and sweet bread in the afternoon.
notes: Affrication /t/ before [i] 'tia' [ˈt͡ʃiɐ], nasal diphthong 'pão' [ˈpɐ̃w̃] and 'ei' 'leite' per barbosa_albano2004 and camara1970.

sentence: O sol brilha forte por cima dos telhados.
ipa: u ˈsɔw ˈbɾiʎɐ ˈfɔɾt͡ʃi poɾ ˈs̺imɐ dus teˈʎadus
gloss_en: The sun shines strongly over the rooftops.
notes: Coda /l/ vocalised 'sol' [ˈsow] and palatal [ʎ] 'brilha' per camara1970 and mateus_dandrade2000.
